whenToUse: A product changelog or release history with versions, dates and typed changes (added, changed, fixed, removed).
Pages that need a linkable anchor per release and an optional filter by change type.
avoidWhen: Record or audit history of who did what — use activity-timeline or audit-log.
Comparing two versions of a document — use version-history.
a11y: Each release is an article labelled by its heading (title plus version); the date is a <time> element and the anchor link has a full-sentence name.
Change types are text tags, not colour only; filter results are announced in a polite live region.
